name: cycle
description: Evidence-gated delivery: an architect, an executor, two independent reviewers and an independent arbiter that judges against your original request.

architect_model.title: Architect model
architect_model.description: Model for planning and task decomposition. Use inherit to follow the session model.

executor_model.title: Executor model
executor_model.description: Model for implementation. This role performs the most tool calls, so prefer a model with reliable tool use.

functional_reviewer_model.title: Functional reviewer model
functional_reviewer_model.description: Model for the completeness and behaviour review. Independence improves when this differs from the security reviewer and the arbiter.

security_reviewer_model.title: Security reviewer model
security_reviewer_model.description: Model for the security and architecture review.

arbiter_model.title: Arbiter model
arbiter_model.description: Model for the final verdict. Correlating this with the architect weakens the boundary it exists to enforce.

operator_model.title: Operator model
operator_model.description: Model for deterministic control-plane calls. A small fast model is sufficient.

architect_effort.title: Architect effort
architect_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

executor_effort.title: Executor effort
executor_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

reviewer_effort.title: Reviewer effort
reviewer_effort.description: Applies to both independent reviewers. low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

arbiter_effort.title: Arbiter effort
arbiter_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

max_repair_cycles.title: Repair cycles
max_repair_cycles.description: Rejected candidates repaired before the workflow blocks. The blocked state preserves all work and can be resumed.

security_proofs.title: Execute security proofs
security_proofs.description: off keeps proofs disabled: the security reviewer states a vulnerability in the review instead of running code to show it, and an undemonstrated critical is downgraded rather than discarded. on lets the reviewer execute a proof it writes against a throwaway copy of the candidate, with this account's privileges and no operating-system sandbox.

gate_strictness.title: Gate strictness
gate_strictness.description: standard fails a change whose layer has no proof. strict also fails on skipped gates. advisory downgrades missing gates to warnings.

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Where workflow state, history, memory and the code index are stored. Leave empty to use the plugin data directory.
